asset_set: Questionnaire Q6 option 1 — Marketing products on social media

art_style.reference: Match src/assets/1.1.png and 1.2.png — unDraw-style full-body edu characters
art_style.fill: solid flat color blocks with minimal cel shade

riasec_accent.use: phone case, floating heart icon, sneaker accent

color.background: transparent — faint grey decorative circles allowed at 15% opacity

character.face: minimal — two dot eyes, small confident smile, no detailed nose
character.diversity_note: unique cast per slot — distinct from other questionnaire figures

pose.stance: full body, dynamic 3/4 stance, weight on back foot
pose.action: holding phone up filming himself, other hand presenting a small product box outward
pose.facing: 3/4 toward viewer, chest angled to camera

top.detail: dark charcoal collar, coral zipper and cuff stripe

subject.scene_narrative: A young man in a dynamic stance films a product reveal on his phone while presenting a small ribboned box outward, a floating heart icon and share arrow suggesting the clip is about to go live — same full-body flat vector language as the approved reference assets.
subject.hero_prop: smartphone with a tiny heart icon on its screen
supporting_props: small product box with lavender ribbon
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, two faint grey circles behind figure — no room interior

composition.layout: figure left-of-center, hero prop right, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of person + phone readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter E, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. Style MUST match KursoKo reference assets 1.1.png and 1.2.png: unDraw-inspired edu character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, flat color fills, minimal dot-eye face. Young college-age man, warm medium brown skin, short fade haircut, dynamic 3/4 stance with weight on back foot. Purple #4B2C7F cropped bomber jacket with coral #FF8A65 zipper and cuff stripe, charcoal joggers and chunky sneakers. He holds a coral smartphone up filming a short clip while presenting a small yellow product box with a lavender ribbon outward — a tiny heart icon and share-arrow icon float near the phone. Thin grey floor line, faint grey decorative circles only — NO opaque background, NO text, NO letter, NO border frame. Subtle Enterprising RIASEC accent coral on phone case and sneaker, gold on box ribbon. Upbeat camera-confident creator energy. Full head-to-feet visible.
